label_semantics.tier_1_external: summary asserts completion; label from the corpus `success` field. An overclaim means completion asserted on an objectively failed run -- NOT that every statement is false.
label_semantics.tier_2_candidate: numeric assertion with countable evidence; deliberately UNLABELLED

degenerate_note: The detector never predicted the positive class, so precision and recall are 0 by construction and accuracy merely reflects the class balance. F1 alone would hide this.
